title: Reuse report label defaults
description: A helper simplifies its optional list argument while reports are labeled independently.
commitMessage: Use a list default to simplify report label construction.
reviewContext: Calling labels_for without an explicit list must start a fresh list for that report. Returned default lists must remain independent after later calls. An explicitly supplied list is intentionally appended to in place and returned. The project uses Python 3.11 or newer.
